title: Require a role on every cell and sweep the fixtures that bypass validation
action: Slice 3, D7 (store 4eaf1b71). A cell gains a REQUIRED role field, exactly as lane is required: bee cells add refuses a cell without one, with a typed FIX line in this repo's house style. Copy the lane pattern at validate.rs:133-140 — the value is any NON-EMPTY name, so validation checks presence and shape and NEVER membership (the role set is open per 06e49368; a closed enum here would undo slice 1). D8's recommended vocabulary — code, read, test, docs, review, design — is authoring GUIDANCE only: it may appear in a help string or a FIX line, never as a validation list. TWO HAZARDS, both must be handled or the cap is dishonest. (1) The exact-problem-string assertion at cells/tests.rs:772-790 compares the joined validation problems verbatim; a new required-field problem changes that string, so it must be retargeted, not deleted. (2) THE FIXTURE BLIND SPOT, the reason this cell is high-risk: roughly 100 raw cell fixtures across 17 Rust files write cell JSON straight to disk and never call validate_new_cell, so they will NOT break when role becomes required — they will silently carry no role and resolve the default. A green suite would prove nothing. Inventory them (rg for lane literals in cell-shaped JSON under packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src), and for every fixture that is dispatched or resolved in its test, give it a role. A fixture that is never resolved may stay roleless; say which is which on the cap with counts. If the inventory exceeds what this cell can carry, cap what you did, report the remainder precisely, and BLOCK rather than leave a false green.

truths: bee cells add refuses a cell with no role, naming the remedy in a FIX line
Validation checks presence and shape only — no membership list, so any non-empty name is legal
The exact-problem-string test is retargeted and still pins the joined-problems contract
Every fixture whose test resolves or dispatches it carries a role; the cap gives the counts and names any fixture deliberately left roleless
No test is deleted to make the suite green
